continuation_tracker: Steps 13-24 continue in Blueprint/pure_engine_v2_steps.json (with the matching narrative in Blueprint/PURE_ENGINE_V2.md).

steps.name: Window + Context Creation
steps.definition_of_done: Blank window opens, stays open, closes without crash
steps.notes: Fixed missing GL loader (GLAD) and clear/swap calls. Verified black window.

steps.name: Render Loop
steps.definition_of_done: Clears screen every frame, tracks delta time, closes cleanly
steps.notes: Added delta time tracking using glfwGetTime(); verified black window updates every frame and closes cleanly.

steps.name: Input Handling
steps.definition_of_done: Key press visibly changes something on screen
steps.notes: Keyboard polled with glfwGetKey() each frame; ESC closes window, SPACE toggles clear color black/dark blue via edge detection (one toggle per press). Verified: no flicker on hold, ESC closes cleanly.

steps.name: Draw One Shape
steps.definition_of_done: Triangle or quad renders via a basic shader
steps.notes: Triangle drawn via inline GLSL shader program (compile/link error-checked) with VAO/VBO vertex setup and glDrawArrays each frame. Verified: orange triangle centered on black; ESC/SPACE still work.

steps.name: Math Layer
steps.definition_of_done: Can translate/rotate/scale shape using own or understood math code
steps.notes: Own header-only math layer, no external library: Vec3 (dot/cross/length/normalized/operators) and column-major Mat4 (identity/translation/scale/rotationZ, multiply, transformPoint) in src/math/. Uniform 'transform' uploaded per frame via glUniformMatrix4fv; rotation driven by deltaTime at 0.9 rad/s. Compile-time verified with static_asserts; visually verified: counter-clockwise rotation ~7s per revolution, ESC/SPACE intact.

steps.name: Sprite/Mesh Rendering + Camera
steps.definition_of_done: Assets rendered in space, camera can move/view them
steps.notes: Own math layer extended with orthographic() (constexpr, static_assert-proven) and lookAt() (view = inverse camera transform built from orthonormal axes). MVP = projection * view * model uploaded per instance via glUniformMatrix4fv; two triangle instances at world (-1.5,0) and (+1.5,0) from identical vertex data, spinning around own centers. WASD pans camera 3 units/s via deltaTime. Visually verified: independent spins, correctly inverted camera pan, ESC/SPACE intact.

steps.name: Basic Object/ECS System
steps.definition_of_done: Game entities represented without hardcoding each one
steps.notes: Simple array-of-structs, not full ECS (design ruling: no payoff at this scale). Header-only src/entity.h: pe::Entity (position/rotationAngle/rotationSpeed/scale) with update(dt) and modelMatrix() = translation * rotationZ * scale. std::vector<pe::Entity> with one update loop and one draw loop replaced hardcoded model1/model2 blocks; third instance (clockwise -1.4 rad/s, 0.6 scale) added as pure data. Visually verified: independent per-entity spins, WASD/SPACE/ESC intact.

steps.name: Collision Detection (AABB)
steps.definition_of_done: Two objects can be detected as overlapping
steps.notes: AABB chosen over circles/exact tests; halfExtents added directly to Entity (0.7071 rotation-safe bound, multiplied by scale at test time). New header-only src/collision.h: constexpr aabbOverlap (separating-axis, AND on both axes) proven by 3 static_asserts. Arrow keys move entities[0] at 2.5 units/s (WASD stays camera); per-frame derived collision flags (unique pairs, j=i+1); fragment shader gained uniform vec3 color — colliding entities render red. Visually verified: both entities red on overlap, instant clear on separation, all prior inputs intact.

steps.name: Audio Playback
steps.definition_of_done: A sound file loads and plays on trigger
steps.notes: miniaudio 0.11.25 via FetchContent (first real CMakeLists.txt change since Step 4). assets/beep.wav generated in-tree by make_beep.ps1 (0.15 s 880 Hz sine with fade envelope). ma_engine_init at startup, sound loaded via 3-candidate relative-path search (hard fail if missing); playback fires on the collision EDGE (anyCollidingNow && !wasCollidingLastFrame), never per-frame; cleanup in reverse creation order. Audibly verified: one beep on collision entry, no repeats while overlapping, silence on separation.

steps.name: Asset Loading
steps.definition_of_done: Textures/models load from files, not hardcoded
steps.notes: Step 9 seams refactored first: per-entity collision-edge detection (previous colliding vector, not a global scalar) and a 4-slot round-robin ma_sound pool. stb_image via FetchContent pinned to commit SHA (stb has no tags); implementation isolated in src/stb_impl.cpp (declare-everywhere/define-once). assets/checker.png generated in-tree by make_checker.ps1 (hand-written PNG, byte-exact). Interleaved position+UV vertex data, sampler2D uniform bound to texture unit 0, color uniform repurposed as tint (collision = red-tinted checkerboard). CMakeLists.txt gained the stb FetchContent block, new source file, and include dir. Verified: checkerboard on all triangles, red tint on collision, second beep fires while another collision is active, all prior inputs intact.

steps.name: Scene/Level Structure
steps.definition_of_done: Can load, hold, and switch between distinct game states
steps.notes: enum class pe::GameState { MENU, PLAYING, PAUSED } + one currentState variable + single dispatch points in main.cpp; push-down stack/scene-graph rejected (Step 7's don't-over-engineer ruling). Pure logic, header-only src/gamestate.h, CMakeLists.txt unchanged. Input forks per state: MENU ESC quits / SPACE starts (resetGame restores the const initialEntities snapshot); PLAYING ESC pauses via NEW ESC edge detector, SPACE toggles clear color, WASD/arrows gated here; PAUSED ESC resumes / SPACE quits to menu. Simulation (entity update + collision + audio edges) wrapped in a PLAYING-only gate, never modified — all Step 1-10 behavior intact. Collision flags hoisted so PAUSED keeps the frozen tint. MENU = dark-purple clear color (no text system yet); texture bind moved inside the gameplay draw path, closing half of Step 10's seam (per-entity textures deferred to Step 12). Fresh clean rebuild passed first try. Verified by user: full state-navigation checklist including frozen-tint pause, exact resume, and world reset.

steps.name: Game Logic Layer
steps.definition_of_done: Franchise-specific gameplay built on top of engine systems
steps.notes: v1 game loop: hostile (5th entity in the same vector, push_back before the initialEntities snapshot so resetGame restores it) chases the player each PLAYING frame via four existing Step 5 Vec3 ops (subtract, normalize, scale by 1.8 units/s * dt, add) with a zero-length guard; slower than the player's 2.5 so escape is always possible. Step 8 pair loop bound fixed at 3 so scenery tint/beep stays byte-identical and the hostile passes through triangles; catch is a separate aabbOverlap(entities[0], hostile) test that prints the survival time to the console, plays a pool beep, and flips to the NEW GAME_OVER state (PAUSED not overloaded; ESC dead there, SPACE -> MENU per Step 11's pattern). GAME_OVER = dark-red clear with the frozen death scene drawn on top. Survival timer = deltaTime accumulation at rate 1 inside the PLAYING gate, reset by one line in resetGame. CMakeLists.txt unchanged (pure logic). Fresh clean rebuild passed first try, zero engine warnings. Verified by user: hostile tracking, scenery pass-through, all Steps 1-11 behavior intact, lose/reset flow correct. All 12 blueprint steps complete.
